description: Experimental variable-length 8-15mer peptide-content classifier trained on SwissProt 2023 protein-family splits.
output_semantics: Independent sigmoid probabilities; categories may overlap and do not sum to one.

training.split: 70/15/15 by protein mnemonic family; exact peptides crossing folds removed

held_out_evaluation.note: Balanced training means the outputs and summary score are ranking signals, not calibrated biological priors.

immunogenicity_evaluation.conclusion: No validated incremental T-cell immunogenicity signal beyond MHC presentation or binding.
